dedupe_keys.name: acidwatch co2 stream chemistry tool portal

description: AcidWatch is an Equinor portal for tools that calculate or predict chemical reactions in carbon-dioxide streams for capture, transport and storage. The public repository contains a Python backend, JavaScript frontend and Docker Compose instructions for local development. Users specify CO2-stream composition and conditions through the supported tools; outputs are calculated chemical indicators for a selected process. Geographic coverage is a user-defined facility or pipeline, not a mapped service area. MIT source is free, while the production portal says some features require an Equinor account with appropriate access. This review used the public repository only and did not test restricted features. A limitation is that reaction predictions depend on species, pressure and temperature assumptions and do not certify pipeline corrosion safety. AcidWatch can help screen CO2 transport and industrial capture scenarios. No directly related catalogue record identifies this portal as a tested component. No credentials, stream data or container images were used.
name: AcidWatch CO2-stream chemistry tool portal
notes: G7 G7-1555. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Some production features require an Equinor account; public source was reviewed without sign-in.
